exact_greek_section.text: Λαβὼν οὖν σταφίδας ἐχούσας γίγαρτα δ’ ἐκκόκισον αὐτὰ τοῖς ὄνυξι, καὶ μὴ τῷ στόματι, καὶ βαλὼν αὐτὰ εἰς ῥάκος περίαπτε τῷ τραχήλῳ ἀγνοοῦντι ἁγνὸς ὧν, καὶ ἀπαλλάξεις Θεοῦ χάριτι.

original_full_historical_source.own_working_english: Therefore take raisins having four seeds; remove them with the fingernails and not with the mouth, put them into a cloth and bind it about the neck of the unknowing recipient, being pure yourself, and you will release [the recipient] by the grace of God.
original_full_historical_source.source_scope: Every instruction and qualifier in section36 is mapped. Sections35 and37 are retained below as context and separate content; neither is claimed to be translated by these37 target groups. The original RAW336 whole I.1 chain remains unchanged.

scope_limits: ἀγνοοῦντι concerns the unknowing recipient; the exact object of ignorance is not supplied by this participle.
ἁγνὸς ὤν concerns the actor’s purity, not the actor’s knowledge and not the recipient’s purity.
γίγαρτα δʹ is retained as the two explicit seed-quantity scopes below; the number of raisins is unknown.
Section35 supplies the quartan/demon/first-decan-Capricorn context; it is a historical attribution, not a verified cause.
Section37 separately claims a head-of-fish stone worn as an amulet releases quartan sufferers. No such stone is silently inserted into section36.
Divine grace and relief remain attributed historical content, not scientific efficacy.

original_fixed_complete_clauses.working_reading: Therefore take raisins containing four seeds [total, or four in each selected raisin].
original_fixed_complete_clauses.reduction: TAKE(A,R); declare CONTAINS(R,G) under Q_TOTAL or Q_EACH below. THE GRAPE_SEEDS first binds G rather than presupposing old I.1.39 seed material. THEREFORE points to the immediately preceding source-context quartan discussion, not to an earlier target operation.

original_fixed_complete_clauses.working_reading: You extract those seeds using your fingernails, not your mouth.
original_fixed_complete_clauses.reduction: EXTRACT(A,G,R,instrument=NAILS(A)); PROHIBIT(EXTRACT(A,G,R,instrument=MOUTH(A))). The command has exactly one extraction event; the negative alternative is not executed. The seed members remain the same G.

original_fixed_complete_clauses.working_reading: You know this rite; the recipient does not know this rite.
original_fixed_complete_clauses.reduction: Assert KNOWS(A,P_rite,t_bind)=true and NOT(KNOWS(W,P_rite,t_bind)). The second object and time are exactly the same as the first by explicit new grammar, not a different purpose or later moment. The actor-knowledge assertion is new guessed target content; the Greek ritual purity is not evidence for it.

original_fixed_complete_clauses.working_reading: Place those seeds in a cloth and bind it on the recipient’s neck.
original_fixed_complete_clauses.reduction: PLACE(A,G,IN(G,C)); BIND(A,C,ON(C,NECK(W))). Seeds must first have been removed from R, and the cloth must contain exactly the same G before binding. The actor is A from YOU; recipient W is the person introduced in C03. No amulet A/S/I from RAW486 is reused.

original_fixed_complete_clauses.working_reading: While you are pure in binding, the source claims that you will release the recipient by God’s grace.
original_fixed_complete_clauses.reduction: Require PURE(A,t_bind), with WHILE binding back to C04 BIND. Record CLAIM(source=I.1.36, RELEASE(A,W,Q) BY_GRACE(GOD)). Q is quartan affliction from I.1.35 context. This requires no actual health-state mutation and supplies no success rate. The lexical YOU remains A, not W.

original_fixed_all11_binding_assumptions.assumption: R,G,C,A,W are this new rite’s entities; the entire section36 target is one case. Q is the quartan condition inherited only as immediate source context from35.
Exactly the seeds selected in the initial raisins comprise G. Three THE SEEDS phrases preserve this membership through extraction and cloth placement.
Quantity has the two fixed TOTAL/EACH scopes; neither the number of raisins nor seed mass is invented.
FINGERNAILS and MOUTH belong to actor A, and NOT_USING scopes solely over EXTRACT. Forbidden mouth extraction is not executed and cannot be repaired by a later purity assertion.
THIS_RITE is the exact P_rite reference macro printed above; both KNOWS cells use the same P_rite and t_bind. The recipient ignorance object is thus more specific than the Greek alone supplies.
YOU is A throughout; actor KNOWS is a guessed additional assertion distinct from source PURE(A). No epistemic implication is inferred from ritual purity.
C04 IN binds seeds to C and ON binds the loaded C to NECK(W). The carrier of G is cloth, not the raisin or a new stone; all omitted actor/recipient arguments are uniquely supplied by A/W.
PURE is evaluated on A at BIND and is independent of knowledge, recipient purity and extraction instrument. The model must not identify ritual purity with hygiene or with the absence of mouth use.
The physical operations are instructed hypothetical actions. A trace that violates an instruction is nonconforming; this is not proof that any medical effect would fail.

The final promise records the source’s attributed RELEASE(A,W,Q) BY_GRACE(GOD). The recipient and affliction arguments are implicit source-context references, not whole-sentence meanings hidden inside YOU.
THEREFORE supplies a source-context discourse connection to35; it does not import an independently confirmed astronomical mechanism or force section37’s different stone into the same case.
